name: Gem-associated protein 2 (Gemin-2) (Component of gems 2) (Survival of motor neuron protein-interacting protein 1) (SMN-interacting protein 1)
features: May play a minor inhibitory role in snRNA binding to 5Sm (SNRPD1, SNRPD2, SNRPE, SNRPF and SNRPG) during snRNP assembly by inserting into the RNA binding pocket of 5Sm
